Issues.Message: Local-static storage may be lifted when declarations and names are unambiguous. Review retained complex static initializers and shadowed names; deleting static changes lifetime.
Preprocessor configuration, types, macros and declarations outside recognized functions are preserved verbatim and require review.
Preprocessor region preserved without selecting a branch. Delimiter-only scaffolding was used during analysis; surrounding code may also be retained when branch structures disagree.
